snippet.title: Trifoil Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Trifoil is a minimalistic puzzle game where you draw lines in clever and unconventional ways. Use cryptic symbols to cross, merge, and manipulate lines as you explore a world filled with puzzles and secrets.   

Play Trifoil Demo:
➤ Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3085710/Trifoil/
➤ Itch: https://andrew-jones.itch.io/trifoil

Wishlist Trifoil:
➤ Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3085710/Trifoil/

Follow Trifoil:
➤ Discord: https://discord.com/invite/ENGxJyZ84S
➤ X: https://x.com/andii1701
➤ Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/trifoil.bsky.social

The trailer and its music were created by Grzegorz Bednorz.
